chinese_source: Baolin Zhuan (801) patriarch list; first extant narratives Zutang Ji (952) and Jingde Chuandeng Lu (1004)
event: First attestation of Prajnatara, Bodhidharma's putative teacher and 27th Indian patriarch: an ATTESTATION record, not a date for a life. No attestation exists in Tanlin, Daoxuan, the Lengjia Shizi Ji, the Fu Fazang list (472), or any Indian, Tibetan, Central Asian or non-Chan Chinese source
firmness_reason: The figure is attested only inside Chan lineage literature and only from 801, ~270 years after Bodhidharma's death; graded contested as a person, firm as an attestation date
notes: Default verdict of the Case 16 build: a lineage construction at the seam where the Fu Fazang list had declared the transmission extinct. A mid-9th-c. Nalanda namesake (folios preserved in Japan via Enchin) is unconnected. The female identification is a modern conjecture (Benson 2008).
